subject: microbiology
title: Innate immunity, complement and antigens

steps.tx: **Innate immunity** strikes without memory: skin and mucosa with lysozyme and defensins bar entry, while **pattern recognition receptors** (TLR4 sensing LPS, TLR5 flagellin, NOD sensing muramyl dipeptide) trigger inflammation. **Phagocytosis** (chemotaxis, opsonin dependent engulfment by C3b and IgG Fc, respiratory burst killing) clears most invaders; **NK cells** kill MHC-I bare targets virally infected, and **interferons** (alpha beta antiviral, gamma macrophage activating) bridge to adaptive responses. Fever with acute phase proteins (CRP, MBL) follows IL-1, IL-6 and TNF.
steps.say: No memory, no delay: innate strikes first. Missing MHC invites NK killing.

steps.tx: **Complement** converges on C3 through three doors: **classical** (C1q binding antibody Fc, needs immune complexes), **lectin** (mannose binding lectin on microbial sugars), and **alternative** (spontaneous C3 tickover amplified on unprotected surfaces, properdin stabilised). Downstream, **C3b opsonises**, **C3a and C5a** (anaphylatoxins) recruit and degranulate mast cells, and **MAC C5b to C9** punches osmotic holes. Regulation (C1 inhibitor, factor H, factor I, DAF, protectin) protects self; paroxysmal nocturnal haemoglobinuria (GPI anchor loss, Ham and sucrose tests, eculizumab) shows regulation failure.
steps.say: Three doors, one C3: classical needs antibody, lectin needs sugar, alternative ticks over. C3b sticks, C5a calls, MAC kills.

steps.tx: **Complement deficiencies** pattern predictably: **C1 inhibitor deficiency** (hereditary angioedema, C4 low with normal C3, danazol or C1 concentrate, no urticaria unlike allergy), **C3 deficiency** (recurrent pyogenic infections, worst opsonic failure), **terminal C5 to C9 deficiency** (recurrent neisserial disease), **factor H deficiency** (atypical HUS with microangiopathy). **Eculizumab** (anti C5, PNH and aHUS) mandates meningococcal vaccination as MAC blockade invites neisseriae. CH50 (classical) with AH50 (alternative) screens; component assays pinpoint.
steps.say: Swelling without itch with low C4 is C1 inhibitor deficiency. Eculizumab demands meningococcal vaccines.

steps.tx: **Antigens** need shape and size: complete antigens immunise alone while **haptens** (penicillin, nickel) need carrier proteins to turn immunogenic. **Epitopes** are the contact patches antibodies grip; **T dependent antigens** (proteins, memory with class switching) differ from **T independent** (polysaccharides, IgM only, no memory, poor infants). **MHC-I** (all nucleated cells, CD8 killers) versus **MHC-II** (antigen presenting cells, CD4 helpers) route responses; **superantigens** (TSST, streptococcal pyrogenic exotoxins) clamp MHC-II outside the groove firing polyclonal storms.
steps.say: Small haptens need carriers to immunise. Polysaccharides make IgM without memory; proteins remember.
